allies.rationale_text: Root-cause-analysis gives causal-attribution-resistance the procedural discipline needed to push past the first blame story toward the actual generative driver.
allies.source_quote: distinguish symptoms, proximate causes, and root causes
allies.affinity_rationale: Core procedural mechanism — 'the procedural discipline needed to push past the first blame story toward the actual generative driver' — provides the structured process that makes CAR operationally executable rather than merely aspirational.
allies.activation_condition: When the team needs a structured procedure to move past the initial blame narrative and systematically distinguish symptoms, proximate causes, and root causes

allies.rationale_text: Critical-thinking strengthens causal-attribution-resistance by forcing skepticism toward the most narratively satisfying explanation.
allies.source_quote: resist the first satisfying cause story
allies.affinity_rationale: Described as foundational — canonical states 'CAR is an advanced form of critical thinking' involving 'the ability to question one's own biases, evaluate evidence, and willingly consider opposing perspectives' — the broader cognitive capacity of which CAR is a specialized application.
allies.activation_condition: When skepticism needs to be directed specifically at the most narratively satisfying causal explanation rather than accepting it because it feels complete and emotionally resolving

allies.rationale_text: Systems-thinking helps causal-attribution-resistance see structural and environmental drivers that a person-centered blame story would miss.
allies.source_quote: look at incentives and structures, not just visible actors
allies.affinity_rationale: Provides the structural framework — canonical states 'Systems thinking provides the framework for CAR' by exposing 'incentives and structures, not just visible actors' — enables seeing structural and environmental drivers that person-centered blame would miss.
allies.activation_condition: When causal analysis is defaulting to individual blame and needs to expand to examine structural incentives, environmental pressures, and systemic design flaws

antagonists.rationale_text: Confirmation-bias undermines causal-attribution-resistance by locking onto the first plausible culprit and selectively reading later evidence through that story.
antagonists.source_quote: premature attribution hardens into a defended causal story
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Powerful locking mechanism — 'A powerful bias where people process information to get a conclusion they want rather than what is true' — locks premature attribution into a defended causal story by selectively filtering subsequent evidence.
antagonists.activation_condition: When the initial causal attribution has hardened into a defended narrative and subsequent evidence is being selectively interpreted to confirm it rather than genuinely test alternatives

structured_tensions.tension_text: Causal-attribution-resistance conflicts with incentive-blind diagnosis when a moralized blame story hides the structural payoffs producing the behavior.
Causal-attribution-resistance conflicts with confirmation-bias when early blame stories are defended instead of reopened as causal evidence accumulates.

Antagonists: confirmation-bias 0.90 (strong — locks premature attribution). Activation conditions assigned.
